records.definition_en: Intake system leak detected (upstream air path)
records.definition_en_relation: technical paraphrase grounded in OEM bulletin
records.translation_ar: رصد تسريب هواء في مجرى السحب، غالباً قبل الشاحن التوربيني
causes: Carbonized EGR pressure-sensor flange; check intake correction below -8% condition
diagnostic_steps: Record CDI N3/40 control-unit software version and air intake correction factors.
Check clean-air and charge-air couplings, air filter, EGR and exhaust pressure intermediate flange as directed by LI.
Perform guided manual air-leak test in XENTRY; the bulletin describes 0.25 bar for its specified test configuration.
Check affected EGR valves, carbon buildup and adaptations; after repair reset air-mass correction learned values before clearing the codes.
